title.zh: Ethereum Foundation and Open Anonymity Launch zkAPI for Privacy-Preserving API P
title.en: Ethereum Foundation and Open Anonymity Launch zkAPI for Privacy-Preserving API P

current_state.zh: The Ethereum Foundation and Open Anonymity Project launched zkAPI on Ethereum mainnet, a zero-knowledge proof payment layer that lets metered API providers verify payment via onchain vault deposits and short-lived spending-capped keys without learning payer identity, initially targeting AI inference.
